children: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Co Holdings extended Chris Schenk's employment as President and Chief Underwriting Officer, increasing his salary, setting a 2026 bonus target, adding a housing allowance and granting stock options.

Term extended through Dec 31, 2028; annual base salary raised from $550,000 to $750,000; 2026 target bonus $1,250,000; $4,500 monthly housing allowance; severance eligibility if agreement not renewed.
